Container.Name: Wise Route Manager
Container.Overview: Safely coordinates Technitium split DNS, LAN reverse-proxy routes, and Pangolin public resources from one clear preview-and-approve workflow. Discovery is read-only; live provider changes stay disabled until you explicitly enable them.

Config.Name: 1. Appdata
Config.Description: Keep this path: it stores route state, encrypted provider credentials, audit history, backups, and generated proxy configuration. Do not delete it when recreating the container.

Config.Name: 2. Master key path
Config.Description: Advanced: path inside the container to the mode-0600 encryption key. Keep the default unless the key is mounted separately and backed up securely.

Config.Name: 3. Enable live changes
Config.Description: Recommended: 0 during setup. Change to 1 only after integrations, read-only discovery, backups, certificates, and the first preview have been verified.

Config.Name: 4. LAN TLS certificate
Config.Description: Required: user-supplied PEM certificate or full chain covering every managed LAN hostname. It must be readable by container UID 1000.

Config.Name: 5. LAN TLS private key
Config.Description: Required: the matching unencrypted PEM private key. Restrict host permissions and keep this mapping read-only.

Config.Name: 6. Management UI
Config.Description: Authenticated Route Manager web interface. Open it from the WebUI link after the container is running.

Config.Name: 7. LAN HTTP
Config.Description: Required for the bundled LAN proxy: redirects HTTP to HTTPS on the container's dedicated br0 address.

Config.Name: 8. LAN HTTPS
Config.Description: Required for the bundled LAN proxy: serves HTTPS on the container's dedicated br0 address using the supplied certificate.
